notes.title: Update #5: Sandbox Mode, Classic Mode & More!
notes.content:
Heya engineers!



It's time for a new update! And it's another big feature request from the early access survey: the sandbox mode, allowing you to set up your train and basically the entire game up to your wishes! There is more of course, but as always, here's the TLDR-overview for this update first:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/4207c255596e52f658e33830c84080a94c5dabcf.png"]And now in more detail:


Sandbox Mode
Do you want to try out the mathematically best possible train configuration? Do you only want to see slot machine stations? Or play with 8 players, where two players have axes and another 2 players have pickaxes to get even more resources? Now you can with the new sandbox mode! 



Here you can configure your train setup and basically the whole game to your liking!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/fedcb3390fd85ad1b7f07656cd816e569322fbb8.gif"]


Classic Mode
A special case of the new sandbox mode is the classic mode, where we tried to recreate the setup of Unrailed 1 as closely as possible. Perfect if you're feeling a bit nostalgic😉

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/70d25707535ef5e4c9af9f6183ead55534e4ba66.gif"]


Classic Soundtracks 🎵
Due to popular demand, we’ve brought back some of the beloved classic soundtracks from Unrailed 1, now played across multiple biomes! Get ready to groove to a fresh version of “Steampipe Sonata” in Autumn Meadows, jam out to “Desperado Desert” in Cargo Canyon, relive “Endtrailed” in Boxcar Bayou, and vibe with “Anchoovy” on Island Interchange.

Also, as a special treat, you can now listen to the complete soundtrack on YouTube. So head there and leave our composers some love ❤️!

[previewyoutube="XhJjIdsylQw;full"][/previewyoutube]

And if you'd like to give us additional support, check out the Steam Soundtrack, which we updated with the new tracks as well!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3398040/Unrailed_2_Back_on_Track__Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink]
New Cartridges
We've also added FOUR new cartridges to unlock for those of you who already have everything:

Meteor: Has a chance to spawn a meteor at the beginning of a map that crashes into the ground and mines resources in a radius

Wagon Buff: Buffs wagons close to you

Insta-Crit: Has a chance to instantly destroy an enemy on the first hit

Grappling Claw (Action Cartridge): Allows you to draw tools and items to you from a distance

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/05dbed52c6450d6556abcdd28718ea413e17a699.gif"]


New Characters
Two new characters are about to join the roster: Spike the cactus and Bernd the Beaver! Also new - thanks to Tana over on our Discord server - the cardboard hat!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/aded2067b2a399ded026e029689747fb61af8f87.gif"]


Free Weekend!
Have you always had a couple of friends or family you wanted to introduce to the world of Unrailed? Now's the perfect time to do so - we are doing a free weekend starting on the 28th August at 7pm CET / 10am PT, where you can play Unrailed 2 for, well, free!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/976dcec2bcaa6320b8a35cfcfb0454297a8a330c.png"]
Changelog
Highlights
- New: Classic Mode
- New: Sandbox Mode (defeat 3 bosses to unlock)
- New: 4 Classic soundtracks from Unrailed remade and added for U2
- New: Cactus & Beaver characters & Cardboard hat added
- New: 4 New cartridges
	Claw action cartridge to draw distant items
	Insta kill NPCs cartridge
	Meteor cartridge
	Wagon buff cartridge

Networking
- New: Online settings menu to reduce bandwidth (increases ping though) or force relay servers
- Improvement: Dynamic extra bandwidth reduction & congestion avoidance
- Bug fix: Lobby browser should be stable now https://u2.unrailed-online.com/#/sessions and allows to join when the game is running by clicking the play button in the browser
- Bug fix: Web map browser creates also a lobby when you’re in the main menu  and clicking the play button in your browser https://u2.unrailed-online.com/#/maps

Balance
- Balance: Ghosted train & fully upgrade a wagon achievement can’t be unlocked in a shop anymore (you must leave it once)
- Balance: Players with tools & buckets don’t get cocooned anymore from the spider boss
- Balance: Magnet pick & claw cartridge and magnet extension can’t pick up from the opposite team in versus anymore
- Balance: Players need to defeat one boss to unlock the Time Mode

Misc
- Improvement: Lobby player count added to the steam rich presence
- Improvement: Buttons that need the privacy policy to be accepted are now hoverable (as they can be clicked)
- Improvement: Default volumes are now all 100%
- Improvement: Better progress bar readability in settings
- Improvement: Cleaner ESC menu
- Improvement: Progress is now shared among all steam users on the device (before the game supported multiple users but it led to confusion)
- Crash fix: Possible crash fix with 8 players
- Bug/Freeze fix: You should now be able to use the keyboard without joining a second player when hovering text fields with the controller. It should probably also fix the freeze issue for some players
- Bug fix: When carrying the cannon cart flag, it was playing the shooting animation even though it’s not shooting
- Bug fix: Cannon cart is sometimes spamming particles in shop
- Bug fix: Lava blob not visible in shop on storage wagon
- Bug fix: Lava blob ropes not visible when its carried
- Bug fix: Wagon remove bubbles sometimes not deleted when scrolling in a replay
- Bug fix: When using the bucket once with a milk wagon, the longer (milk wagon) effect duration stood even when milking directly an animal afterwards
- Bug fix: Auto-track pickup from a mimic as a crafter did not work
- Bug fix: Transformer drops items with box pull extension
- Bug fix: Bot looped with a transformer with box push and pull
- Bug fix: Controller rumble reenables every restart
- Bug fix: There was a locked non-existing cartridge slot in the cartridge shop
- Bug fix: Game sometimes showed the same unlock pop-ups after starting the game
- Bug fix: Selection in highscore menu sometimes flipping down
- Bug fix: When remapping a split input, it wasn’t possible to navigate through the menus anymore
- Bug fix: When remapping a split input and restarting the game, the new mapping got mixed with the default mapping

notes.title: Freeze fix & Can't join friends fix [UPDATE]
notes.content:
Hi everyone!



We have an issue with our highscore server hoster and we're working on a fix (unfortunately we seem to be dependent on them at this point).

This occasion showed us that the game doesn't handle it as smoothly as it was supposed to. This patch removes all blocking/freezing issues related to that and shows a simple "highscore server cannot be reached" message.

Note that we only host the custom maps and the highscores and the rest of the game should be fully functional. That means creating / joining / playing online in private or public sessions should work completely fine even when our highscore server is down.

Make sure to update the game and let us know if you have further issues!



 Changelog v-557-400fab4

Bug fix: Occasional game freezes (when starting and sometimes later as well) when the highscore server cannot be reached. Now an small notification will appear ("Highscore server cannot be reached.") but the rest of the game should not be affected

\[Update]

We also found a major issue where player could not join other players anymore when the highscore server wasn't reached correctly. This has been fixed as well and might have been a huge issue in China for instance.



Changelog v-557-236fcce

Bug fix: Joining other players might not be possible when the highscore server wasn't reachable



We are really sorry for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Update 4: New Biome, New Wagon and a New Crewmate!
notes.content:
Hey Engineers,

We have quite a few new updates waiting for you in Unrailed 2! 

If you'd like a quick summary, here's a TLDR image and a trailer if that's more your thing:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/7611bb4885cba6e8b85cfd5f936149427f1ccd54.png

[previewyoutube=qNY5S7NINFg;full][/previewyoutube]

And now here comes the detailed breakdown of everything new:

Navigate your way through Loco Labyrinth!

Get ready, there’s a new biome and this one isn’t always what it seems… 

Loco Labyrinth will make your head spin by constantly shifting its terrain, so make sure you keep an eye on what’s ahead and work hard not to lose those precious tracks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/d601bb7ef402554502840f4face5a484918ff104.gif

A new biome means new NPCs joining the chaos fun! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/d947473ae990a158ee06e7484eaa9d04a50299e5.png

This curious snail is our newest ridable and though it might look cute, you wouldn’t want them near your tracks. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/dc9a6fcb752e8cd612d7a9d2d852f2fa9d426556.png

Want to find out more about the latest boss? [spoiler]We could tell you more, but where’s the fun in that?![/spoiler]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/1cd32c2880fb899a0cc05ba598015d572c576fd6.png

The Mimic Tree is a sneaky imposter that lurks amongst the trees and seems innocent enough until you get a little too close. Don’t say we didn’t warn you!

Speaking of an imposter…


Crewmates Are Now Boarding!

We’re delighted to announce that we’ve collaborated with our friends Innersloth to bring their Among Us Crewmates to Unrailed 2!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/273664e452992d2f88bf056dc47b0cc152e888f1.gif

Although you can’t call emergency meetings, what better character to play as when you go head-to-head with your friends in VS Mode. Pick your favourite colour from 8 variations to distinguish yourself and let the chaos begin!

The Crewmate is available in the Fashion Express once you unlock it by [spoiler]leading another teammate to their demise![/spoiler]


New Mimic Wagon!

A new biome wouldn’t be the same without a special brand-new wagon!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/7556b11b772dd0df8afa515bee3264fa00c155e6.gif

The Mimc Wagon cleverly clones the look and ability of the wagon in front of it, so keep that in mind when you’re building your train.


New Teleporter Wagon!

Next to the Mimic wagon you can now also find the Teleporter wagon at the shop! It carries a teleporter that can be placed on the map that can be used to teleport players between the wagon and the teleporter.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/8027a6e233986dfe08b3ee117d687565f80eef39.gif


New Brake Track Crafter Wagon!

This wagon takes normal track pieces as input and crafts brake tracks, that, as the name suggests, brake the train when it passes over them. It's definitely useful to bring a few brake tracks with you when the train speed gets pretty high!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/edf60604490225457dd71f909e6cce100184ed14.gif


Further improvements and balancing!

Based on your feedback, we tried to make more wagons interesting and also damped the speed curve on higher speeds. For instance, the Cannon Wagon allows you to pre-place tracks, the pusher engine buffs neighbouring wagons by 2 levels, the Miner, Slot and Cartridge Toaster and other wagons were buffed. The one downside of all the balancing improvements is that we'll have to open a new list of highscores, but as usual, you can still access the old ones via u2.unrailed-online.com.


Tell Your Friends!

With so many exciting updates we thought we'd add one more: Unrailed 2 is 25% OFF in the Kepler Publisher Steam Sale until 22nd May! Tell your friends, or make some new ones in our Discord, and enjoy all the chaotic fun.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2211170/Unrailed_2_Back_on_Track/

Aaand that's it! Thanks a lot to everyone that shared their feedback and ideas with us since the launch and everyone that helped test the new features on the experimental branch. And do let us know what you think of all the new stuff either here or on our Discord server!


Changelog

In case you still want more detail, here's the changelog for this update:

Highlights

 New: Labyrinth biome
 New: Brake track crafter wagon
 New: Teleporter wagon (special wagon for Boiler Badlands)
 New: Mimic wagon (special wagon in Labyrinth)
 New: Among Us crewmate character added
 Change: New highscore split starting from this version

Endless

 Balance: Fixed speed increase at higher distances (~0.34 m/s)
 Balance: More gradual speed increase over multiple rounds (the first speed increase won't exceed the highest speed previously reached)
 Balance: Speed reductions from slot stations are only active in the current biome (but reappear more often in subsequent biomes)

Cartridges

 Balance: Axe and pickaxe cartridges capped at 10
 Balance: Animals restore 9 health when ridden using the saddle action cartridge
 Balance: When hit by a torpedo while riding, the player unmounts, the torpedo explodes, and the animal survives
 Balance: Milk from animals now buffs for 12 seconds (was 20). Milk from the milk wagon buffs for 15 seconds (level 1), 20 seconds (level 6), and up to 25 seconds when supercharged. Time-increase extensions can now also influence effect duration
 Balance: “Don’t build more than 2 tracks ahead” task no longer appears when the train is moving faster than 0.5 m/s

Wagons

 Improvement: Players can pre-build “virtual” tracks using the cannon wagon’s flag
 Balance: Teleporter wagon replaces the task wagon as the special wagon in Boiler Badlands (still appears normally in Versus)
 Balance: Pusher engine supercharges neighboring wagons by +2 levels. It now starts between the box and crafter by default. Its range increases after each boss
 Balance: Conveyor belt wagon removed from Endless, Time, and Versus modes (still available in the editor)
 Balance: Cannon wagon starts with an input size of 3 (was 1), scaling up to 10 (was 6) at level 6
 Balance: Brake wagon reduces speed by up to 1 m/s (still 75% reduction up to that limit)
 Balance: Cartridge toaster requires fewer animals per level (now 4)
 Balance: Printed wagons gain an additional extension slot
 Balance: Magnet pick extension in Endless picks up items slightly slower
 Balance: Range decrease extension now behaves symmetrically to range increase
 Balance: Collector wagon picks items every 1 second (was 2.5 seconds) at level 1 and starts with a picked item stack size of 5 (was 3)
 Balance: Compactor wagon now takes 6 seconds (was 8) at level 1, and 2.5 seconds (was 3) at level 6
 Balance: Consecutive wins in slot wagon now yield better rewards:

 Compressed commodities (half stack size)
 Brake tracks (half stack size)
 Dynamite with +1 range per consecutive win

 Balance: Track crafter with water supercharge now generates at least 1 second of heat per crafted track (as long as crafting duration exceeds 1 second, nothing changes)

Versus

 New: Teams can now be fixed in Versus mode. If enabled, new players become spectators, team switching is disabled, and the game pauses on player disconnect
 New: Team switching now possible via the ESC menu
 New: Adjustable speed multiplier (1x = Endless speed, 2x = 2 stations’ worth of Endless progress per station)
 New: Special accessories unlockable by us (for Naos competition)
 Balance: Speed for the second team is now 150% (was 200%) + 5% (was 3%) per second

Editor

 New: Snails, Mimic trees, and Labyrinth biome (theme) available
 New: Brake track wagon and Teleporter wagon available

Time Attack

 Bug fix: Wagons sometimes not attaching to the train
 Bug fix: Time mode map could go out of sync on the same seed
 Change: Extra life removed from Time mode
 Change: 3 (was 2) cartridges per map in Time mode

Misc

 New: Updated macro map in main menu
 New: "Each player must milk an animal" task added
 New: "Lift animal X times" task added
 New: Motion sickness mode for Labyrinth (disables wobbly ground effect)
 Improvement: Sound & music updates
 Improvement: Biome names shown during transitions
 Improvement: Octoboss now visible and animated in the blueprint area after its boss map
 Improvement: Full lobbies now also visible at the bottom of the lobby browser
 Improvement: Shrine tracks now rendered as brake tracks (still need to be flipped)
 Improvement: Crewmate and supporter pack unlock conditions now shown in Fashion Express
 Improvement: Slot wagon performance improved; Credits performance also improved
 Change: Speed warning bubble now only shown for 3 stations and reworded more positively
 Bug fix: Bot failed to build tracks properly in Boiler Badlands boss map (was building backward)
 Bug fix: Saddle perk tutorial always active
 Bug fix: Carriage wagon sometimes failed to pull previous wagon
 Bug fix: Brake wagon sometimes didn’t recharge
 Bug fix: Achievements triggered during replays
 Bug fix: “Keep crafter wagon busy” task auto-completed during blueprint transitions; task now resets properly on high crafting speeds
 Bug fix: "+X hexnuts" text in the main menu sometimes froze or repeated
 Bug fix: Engine description didn’t reflect the 13-wagon cap
 Balance/Fix: Animals now guaranteed to spawn in specific counts on maps

notes.title: All Aboard for Our Spring Updates + Collaborations!
notes.content:
Heya Engineers!

Spring is almost here and we’re delighted to bring you some exciting updates… but first, tell your friends, your family, your pets (they might want to play too!), Unrailed 2 is currently 20% off in the Steam Spring Sale until March 20th. 

Now onto the updates! First, here’s a TLDR image if you’re in a hurry:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/0668173239115713cb05e9ea0d6cdb9e39a5cf6d.png

Choo-riffic Collaborations

We’re excited to announce a double collaboration with our friends over at Awaceb and The Gentlebros! 

All the way from the Purribean and New Caledonia, this pawsome Cat from Cat Quest III and Tchia from, well, Tchia have swapped their ocean adventures for train track chaos in Unrailed 2!

Both of these adorable characters are available right now in the Fashion Express.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/a4b3ab2d37dcd297d6b3ca729646c013a9a1c84a.png
If you are new to these games, Cat Quest III is 30% off and Tchia is 60% off in Steam’s Spring Sale until March 20th.

A New Character Hops Onboard

Hopping onto the train is our latest character! Say hello to Rory 🐰
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/bfb53d51dab5ca44b380cb93fbdb26aedd9df272.png
To unlock Rory you’ll need to play a Time Mode match. What’s a Time Mode match we hear you ask? You’ll find out in 3, 2, 1…

Time Attack Mode

Time Attack Mode is a brand new feature where you’ll get the whole game experience in a 20-minute burst. Expect lots of upgrades to be available, but you better be quick on your feet, the train will get faster the more time goes on.

For players looking to challenge themselves, you might be able to play for a further few minutes if you can keep up with the runaway train.

Who’s up for a challenge?

notes.title: Action Cartridges Bring You More, Well, Action!
notes.content:
Heya engineers!

We're back with a smaller update that introduces a new cartridge type, expanded soundtrack, record breaker rewards, balancing updates and bugfixes. Here's a TLDR-image:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/83f754e1415b95b6e0a2014d25304ad347d0bfc0.png

Or a TLDR-video if that is more your style:
[previewyoutube=J9KHqnOxLPk;full][/previewyoutube]

A New Type of Cartridge: the Action Cartridge
Action cartridges are called that because compared to the other cartridges they are not passive - you can choose when to activate them by the press of a button. They are also more powerful than normal cartridges and you can only ever have one type of action cartridge, so choose wisely! There are three all new action cartridges and we've reworked two existing cartridges (throwing and saddle) into action cartridges. This makes throwing a bit more balanced and saddle a lot more competitive.

New Night and Rain Versions of the Soundtrack
The soundtrack now dynamically adapts when it rains or the night draws - for a much more atmospheric listening experience! The new tracks will also be added to the official soundtrack!

Record Breaker Crowns
We've added a little reward for those at the bleeding edge of Unrailed 2 competition: Record breaker crowns. If you inhabit a place at the top of the leaderboards you'll get the golden crown hat, if you're in the top 3 you get the silver crown and in the top 10 you get the bronze crown. An elegant way to distinguish yourself from the regular Unrailed crowd.

Balance Updates
In combination with the new action cartridges we also tweaked the balance of all cartridges and how and where cartridges appear in game. This should have little effect for players just starting out, but prevents high level players from hoarding huge amounts of cartridges too early. This means that we'll have a new highscore-list, but the old highscores will also still be visible online.

Midweek Sale
To round things up, Unrailed 2 is currently doing a Midweek Sale, so if you haven't already gotten a copy yet, or need to convince friends and family that they should get one, this is your chance!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2211170/Unrailed_2_Back_on_Track/

Cartridges
- New: Introduced max cartridge counts for some cartridge when the effect doesn’t scale indefinitely
- New: A new cartridge slot “Action Cartridge” has been introduced. Players can only own one action cartridge type. Action cartridges use a button (eg [CTRL]/(Y)) to perform the action. Action cartridges are throwing, riding and a some new ones. Note that the cartridge overwrite can’t overwrite action cartridges.
- New: Ghost-Action-Cartridge
- New: Stomp-Action-Cartridge
- New: Jetpack-Action-Cartridge
- New: Hurry-Action-Cartridge
- Change: Riding Cartridge is now an Action-Cartridge: To ride, you need to press the action-cartridge-button. Riding works only a limited time that is based on the amount of riding cartridges you have. While riding, you can do carry/mine/etc and you automatically get the milk buffs of the animal you’re riding
- New: A cartridge (history) selection menu when joining a game in which you missed opportunities to get cartridges. Can also be access via ESC->Cartridge History
- New: “Marathon: Higher probability for longer maps” cartridge added (not distributed at slot stations, similar to hard/easier maps)

Sound & Music
- New: 26 additional soundtrack versions added for night/rain/ebb. Each existing soundtrack will dynamically transition to another version at night, when it’s raining and during ebb/tide (on island interchange)

Highscore
- New: Ingame Crowns for any top 10 highscore entry (week, month, year or all time and can be any engine).
- New: You can see personal highscores online when clicking on a name

Mapgen

notes.title: Experimental Version Update

Hey everyone!

We just pushed a big update on experimental previewing upcoming changes.

A lot is about trying to balance the cartridges and introducing a special cartridge type, the "Action-Cartridge". For that, a new start-slot can be bought in the cartridge hub. Throwing and saddle (which has been reworked now) are action cartridges and we added a bunch more: ghost, stomp & a jetpack. Players can only have one action cartridge type which allowed us to change the saddle-cartridge such that you have to press a button to mount (and more.. see the changelog). We probably need a lot of feedback here, so let us know what you think!

Furthermore, there was often the wish for better cartridge balance when joining late into a game. You can now choose among selected cartridges of other players for each boss or extreme node after joining. It doesn't allow to change start cartridges though - we're still into looking that.

We also started a better highscore integration, giving players an ingame crown when being in one of the highscore lists. It's not yet possible to watch replays from others but that is in the pipeline as it has been requested :).

As we rebalanced things a bit, starting from the experimental version, the online highscores are now split.

We're also still working on some controller input issues with newer MacOS versions that might make it hopefully into the next patches.

notes.title: Holiday Update Has Arrived!
notes.content:
Heya Engineers!

With the holidays just around the corner, we've got a seasonal content update for you! 

Here's an image of all the new things for your TLDR purposes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/99882a20a124459ff1e191db3e5c83ab8fdf0ac7.png
Now let's dive into the details:

Crumbly Returns!
We’ve freshly baked a new batch of our Gingerbread friend and are pleased to announce that they are unlockable together with a festive hat right now until January the 30th! All you have to do is [spoiler]to find a snowman and chop it down![/spoiler]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/2f49502c402449112c2e85c24bf441e31abec10d.png
In addition to our newest character joining Unrailed 2’s roster, we’ve added some more updates.

Steam Achievements and Trading Cards
Yep, you read correctly, Steam Achievements and Trading Cards are now available. Get back on track with Unrailed 2 and earn achievements along the way.

Bot Improvements
We've heard your feedback and invested quite some time into improving the bot experience. Here's what we've changed:

 The bot can destroy moles, webs, bones or canyon mountains
 The bot automatically extinguishes the train in wagon mode if there's nothing else to do
 The bot can now also handle supercharger, miner, collector, magnet, compactor, transformer, carriage, ghost, slot, piggybank and brake wagon
 The bot now avoids getting wiped out or cocooned by enemies

Level Editor Improvements
We've also made a couple of improvements to the terrain conductor mode:

 The editor allows to place extensions on wagons to have them start with these extensions
 The editor allows to place cartridges on spawn points to equip them to players
 The engine counts down at the beginning of a custom map (this does not affect old maps)

Control Fixes
We got reports from several players that input devices would disconnect or the game would not or would receive wrong inputs. We've completely changed the input handling to fix this issue. Do let us know on our Discord Server if you still have input issues though! And you can always switch back to the old input system by adding "++ --noSDL" to your launch options. You can edit your launch options by right clicking on the game in your Steam library, then clicking on "Properties..." and adding it to the field at the bottom of the "General" tab.

Ghost Engine
Do you sometimes wish your entire train was ghosted? Well now you can make your whish come true with the new ghost engine!


Soundtrack and Supporter Pack
We know you love the Unrailed 2 Soundtrack just as much as we do, and we are delighted to announce that the soundtrack is now available to purchase! 🎶

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3398040/Unrailed_2_Original_Soundtrack

Along with the Original Soundtrack, we have launched a Supporter Pack filled with extra goodies for all those who would like to support Unrailed 2’s development.

 Four exclusive characters.
 A special piggy respawn balloon 🐷
 13 wallpapers featuring the cast of Unrailed 2.

To find out more about the Soundtrack and Supporter Pack (DLC), check out the link below.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48352/Unrailed_2_Supporter_Bundle

Winter Sale

Don’t know what to get your friends for the holidays? Unrailed 2 could make the perfect gift with the new holiday update, plus it’s currently 20% OFF in the Steam Winter Sale!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2211170/Unrailed_2_Back_on_Track/


Over the holiday season we'll be less active than usual, but please know that we'll get back to you about any bugs/feedback as soon as we can.


We wish you all a very Happy Holidays! ❄️⛄️

- Indoor Astronaut

notes.title: Community Spotlight #1 + Tips For the Level Editor
notes.content:
Heya Engineers!

The Unrailed community continually inspires us and something we would like to start doing every month or so is feature some of your creations in our Community Spotlight posts. This could be anything from fan art, funny clips, maps you’ve created in Terrain Conductor mode (which in case you didn’t know is a level editor where you can create your own Unrailed maps!), screenshots from your playthroughs, or maybe you’ve seen a really cool train IRL and would like to share a photo. 

If you’d like to submit your creations for your chance to be featured, you can either post them in our Discord in the channel called ‘community -creations', you can also share screenshots, artwork and video in our Steam forum - please make sure they adhere to our Community Rules.

For our first Community Spotlight we’re going to focus on the Terrain Conductor!

You’ve been super creative crafting customs maps in the Level Editor and it was extremely tough to choose. We eventually narrowed it down to 3 maps we’d like to feature this month:

Throw and Shoot

This map makes you search for the station and includes hidden upgrades, wagon extensions and cartridges everywhere!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/0fd99e85b1c5720260b365b07fd550fc48fa11a3.png
Created by yuita.
Map link.


Divided Straight 2 Player

This map forces you on two separate paths - you’ll have to pass tools and resources between them to get to the station.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/c68f53e347e7d6c2fe9cc3317d617d9e8c113bac.png
Created by れもぬってん.
Map link.


Bombing Pioneer

Here the path to the station is simple - but can you blow your way to the needed tracks in time?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/a49753d3242e1aeb9bedee80e22d2068eac70a76.png
Created by れもぬってん.
Map link.


Want to see even more maps created in our Level Editor? Check them out here.

Tips For Creating Your Custom Level


 Let your creativity guide you. Whether you enjoy creating a serene landscape full of resources or maps full of hazards for players to overcome, the Level Editor is your oyster (without the seafood smell).
 Beginners might find it easier to lay the ground across the whole blueprint and chip away once you get into the full swing of your level design.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/854143e8e8b9e02140a741f755c430ce6304eea2.png

 Add hazards such as NPCs, laser beams, barriers, or a boss to make things interesting!
 Speed things up-or slow them down with a variety of tracks to choose from.
 Set camera tracking points to control what the camera shows when the map is being played. A camera point will save the current camera position and zoom when placing it. When playing, the game will interpolate between the closest camera tracking points to the engine

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/77fbc6413970f7005820519642340b3931c4d6dd.png

How do I share my map with the rest of the community?
Once you’ve crafted your level you can use the top-right drop-down menu to either play your level or publish it to the rest of the community and see it.

notes.title: Unrailed 2 Community Update: More Improvements!
notes.content:
Heya engineers!

We're back with another update to cover what we've been working on since our previous community update.

There's been a lot of feedback here and on our Discord server and we're working hard to incorporate as much as possible as fast as possible! Here's a selection of new QOL-features, balancing and bugfixes implemented since the last update (for more info take a look at the individual changelogs here, here, here, here, here and here):

Quality of Life Improvements

Save game recovery that enables you to save the game at the start-up after a crash.
Improved automatic graphics-driver detection when starting the game.
All D-Pad buttons are now per default emoji/bot-shortcuts. The control-drawer is not left-stick-press on controller.
Online lobbies are now by default private.
Lobby browser doesn't show full lobbies anymore.
UI-Scaling option in settings.
Replay menu added.
Picking items from wagon has lower priority when not faced directly to make it easier picking up items in front of a wagon.
Torpedos are not grid aligned anymore.
The storage-push extension now pushes to the closest storage-wagon that is free instead of waiting for the closest one to free up.

Balancing Updates

The toy-engine doesn't loose bolts on crash anymore, and toy-engine saves can be loaded multiple times.
The slot machine station now takes at most 4 tries to win.
Map rotations removed as they led to confusion or motion sickness for some players. We're working on a solution to have them back but still solve the two issues with it.
Balancing: Nether and Lollipop cartridge don’t cancel anymore but lead to a very easy and very hard path when both are equipped.
Octoboss waits slightly before it starts shooting water and shoots less often.
The turret prioritizes trees and rock before canyon-mountains.
Wagons, cartridges or extensions taken in versus will now also unlock

Crash and Bugfixes

Crash in the lobby due to certain usernames.
Crash that happened with corrupt progress or save files.
A crash could happen on deleting a custom map.
Game could freeze when walking on a waiting area in a shop.
The station was showing the wrong number of bolts when the map had a cassette.
The wagon printer was spawning a new wagon where it could not be picked up.
The game-window was not being in focus on start. This could lead to the impression that the controller was not working.
The map-generation was taking a long time on in the island biome.
The engine and skin buildings were not appearing in the main menu.
The toy-engine was crashing multiple times at the end of the credits.
Some players were not able to open the lobby browser or enter any kind of online lobby - let us know whether this fixed your case.
Wrong resolution shown in settings for Mac users.
Sometimes it was not possible to connect the stated amount of animals to a milk wagon.
The front-pull extension was sometimes not working with the carriage wagon.
Animal attached to the milk wagon should not be squashed as easy as before and should survive biome transitions.
Nether and lollipop cartridges were drawable at the slot station.
Respawning was broken when being killed while riding an animal.
Milk wagon milk effect stacking was broken.
Reduced camera flickering in replays.
Water draining during dialogs.
Hide player out of screen bubbles during loading screen.
Versus wagon was not added to handbook (now it’ll be added the the first versus station).
Final station was not added to the handbook.
Tools on ground were sometimes invsibile.

and more...

We are aware that there are still people having problems connecting to lobbies and encountering crashes. We've listed a couple of workarounds in the last post here and also here. However, if these do not help, please contact us directly either in the Steam forums or even better on our Discord server where we can then try our best to help you individually. 

We're continuing to bugfix and add improvements to make your experience of Unrailed 2 even better

notes.title: Unrailed 2 Community Update: Bugs & Bug fixes
notes.content:
Heya engineers!

First of all thanks a lot for everyone that already got the game and is busy building some train tracks! With the game just out we are getting a ton of feedback and try our best get to it as quick as possible. In the following we'll list what we've already added, what bugs we've fixed, problems and possible workarounds and which bugs are on our radar.

New Feature: Button Remapping
One of the big feature requests we've gotten so far is the support for button remapping. We've just now implemented a first version that enables you to remap the most important buttons! You can find more info about it here.

Fixed Bugs
We're currently hard at work to address the bug-reports we are getting. We've already pushed a few hotfixes (which you can review in detail here, here,here and here). In short, they address the following issues among others:

 Crash when not accepting the privacy policy
 Crash fix for a certain languages (probably in the menu)
 Polish font rendering issues
 Certain usernames causing crashes
 The safe-mode option not showing up on mac
 A few localization issues

Potential Workarounds if the Game Does Not Start or Runs Slowly
Here are some known issues we're seeing and potential workarounds you can try:

Error message from windows when starting "Video card does not support Direct3D 12": We suggest trying to run the "Safe Mode" starting option that is offered via Steam (after pressing the play button in steam).

 If the safe mode is running, you will be able to change your video options and especially the driver being used. We suggest trying out all drivers listed (e.g. DirectX12, Vulkan, OpenGL, OpenGL + Angle). Note that you need to start the game in normal mode again to apply the driver settings. Very old hardware probably only runs via OpenGL or OpenGL + Angle.
 If the safe mode is not running, reach out to us with your system specs. We need to check on an individual basis if we can fix it or whether the hardware is not supported anymore.

Playing the game locally is running slow and laggy: We suggest trying to see whether this issue persists when lowering the video settings (and especially disable VSync!). If the issue doesn't go away, please reach out to us and we check on an individual basis.

China-Specific Issues

If you are playing the game from China we have received reports of issues regarding the online networking. Here are the issues we are currently working on and some workarounds that might already help you now:

Game laggy after connecting to an online session/ Inability to enter non-accelerated online lobbies after activating VPN services like UU Accelerator: We're working on a general solution, but this will take some time. As background information, the game only needs a connection to a server to establish the initial connection and for listing rooms. Afterwards we send data via peer-to-peer (P2P) without the need of any servers from us. Only if a P2P connection fails, a relay server is being used. Thus, if playing with friends abroad (e.g. non-China to China), using an accelerator might help. When playing with your friends in China, it is helpful if either all friends all use the same accelerator or none use it at all.

Can't start the game because of no connection (warning the the splash screen):
The game only needs to access the internet ONCE when starting the first time. No internet connection is needed anymore for playing the game locally.
If you have internet and still get this message your firewall might block the connection or even an accelerator or VPN. We suggest checking your firewall settings and trying without and with accelerator or VPN. We're working on a solution to reduce this issue. You can test whether you can reach our servers by checking if https://u2.unrailed-online.com loads in your browser.

Bugs on Our Radar
Finally, here are all the rest of the known bugs we have not fixed yet, but we will tackle them as soon as possible:

 Problems connecting controllers/ game freezing when plugging in a controller

notes.title: What to expect of Unrailed 2!
notes.content:
Heya Engineers!

Ahead of release, we wanted to give you some insight into what you can expect from Unrailed 2’s Early Access launch and what is still to come. You can also find a chart with the global release times and a mini AMA further down below!

So what is in the game at Early Access launch?

Biomes: The game offers five biomes in total at launch. Each biome has it's own unique game mechanics and a boss to beat at the end.

Unlockables: On your journey you can find a whole bunch of different kinds of stations to upgrade your train with new wagons or by equipping cartridges to get access to new abilites. And of course there's a bunch of characters and equipment to unlock.

Gamemodes: Next to the endless mode, where you try to build a train track as far as possible, theres also 4v4 versus mode where you can go head-to-head with up to 8 friends and terrain conductor mode that allows you to build and share your own Unrailed levels. This one is the newest addition and there's a lot we can improve still. So let us know what you want to see added!

Local & online multiplayer: As with Unrailed 1 we’ve focused on ensuring you can play all that toghether with your friends both locally and online, with the flexibility to combine these modes. You can have multiple players join locally and connect to an online session hosted by someone who may also have multiple local players.

Singleplayer: If you choose to go for singleplayer mode you can either play alone or with a bot companion along your side. Please note that it's still in an early stage and may not yet fully replace the experience of playing with friends at the start of Early Access.

And what's to come?

First things first: As with Unrailed 1 and the Beta of Unrailed 2 we first and foremost want to work on what you, our community, feels is important. That means we'll first gather your feedback on our Discord server and tackle whatever bugs, gameplay issues or balancing problems you come across (there probably will be a couple 😅). We want to ensure the game is stable and a ton of fun to play before we release major new content updates.

New content: We already have a couple of areas in mind where we want to extend Unrailed 2. These include

 Biomes and bosses that add replayability and reveal more about the world of Unrailed (and why it's so difficult to build a train with brakes 😉).
 Engines, wagons, wagon extensions and cartridges that allow you to synergize with your team and specialize your strategy for building train tracks efficiently further.
 New gamemodes next to the current three. Here we want to experiment with a Time Mode once again or other ideas like a classic mode.
 More characters and equipment to unlock to stand out among your peers.
 Achievements!


QoL and balancing updates: While new content is exciting, we'll always try to improve existing systems. This includes:

 Technical and performance improvements to make sure we can run on as many machines as possible.
 Rewards for hiking the leaderboards (how about the top players getting a crown to wear?)
 Key-remapping.
 Gameplay and visual improvements to make track building even more enjoyable.
 Extra lobby features (banning, or a quick chat that would complement the current emoji menu...)


But again, these things might change depending on where early access takes us. We'd love to hear what ideas you come up with or where your gripes are. Either for something listed above or something totally different! We're super thankful for all the support and feedback we've already gotten during the closed Beta and open Beta and Demo events we want to continue working like this.

If you want all that roughly in image form, here you go:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/9190da67b34aeb1b93246a16ceb5c92791bb11e9.png

Thank you for joining us ❤️

Release Times Around the World

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771583/72bdfb1e73096b82adf9154fbda021ca0a7b4c71.png

Mini AMA

During the Steam Next Fest we asked on Discord for some of your burning questions, and we have some answers for you.

Will Unrailed 2 support Steam Remote Play?
Yes.

Will the soundtrack be available to purchase?
It will, but sometime after launch. We’ll announce when it’s available across our social channels.

Will progress from demo transfer to Early Access?
Yes.

Will there be game saves in Early Access? If so, will the game save automatically after every station/biome, or something else?
You can create a save game as the host of a session at any time (via menu -> Save and quit to lobby). Note that saves can be loaded only once, similar to U1. However, using the toy engine, you can restart at every station once you crash.

Will people without the full game be able to join a friend that does have the full game if they receive an invite?
We do not have a separate version for that but we support Steam Remote Play which allows anyone to join a friend’s Unrailed 2 session.

Will Unrailed 2 be coming to consoles and will there be cross-play?
We’re currently focusing on bringing Unrailed 2 to Steam for Early Access, and then looking into consoles later on. 

Can I join the same lobby as my friends if they live in a different country?
Sure. This might introduce more lag though.	

How long will Unrailed 2 be in Early Access?
We cannot give a definite timeline yet as we’ll be collecting feedback from our community to make the game a super fun experience. Our first game, Unrailed! was in Early Access for roughly a year, and we think Unrailed 2 will be similar.

Since we got quite some messages from players trying to start the game with pre Vulkan & DX12 (or pre shader model 6) GPUs, we added the compatibility backend which runs via OpenGL or ANGLE. It's hard to say whether the game runs fast enough on such old hardware but we got it running on our dusty GTX 560. It might even run on those Intel HD 4000 chips, but we have none to test.
